dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.l02: The footsteps behind you. The shape between the trees, gone the moment you looked.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.l03: That was me. It has always been me.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.l04: My name was Cyrrus. I was a traveller once, like you. I climbed to the Sovereign's crown, and asked the storm to answer me.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.l05: It answered. It filled me, until there was nothing left but wind.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.l06: You carried my heart out of the dark. You set my eyes in stone. You read my journal.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.l07: Thank you. You have woken me completely.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.l08: Now — let the sky decide which of us walks home.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.phase2: The rain will take your eyes. You won't need them.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.phase3: You hold your ground. The wind will fix that.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.phase4: Come, children of the squall. Feed on them.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.phase5: No more voices. Only the storm.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.d02: Strange. I can hear my own footsteps again.
dialogue.stormreach.cyrrus.d03: Keep the crown, traveller. Don't ask it for anything.

item.stormreach.glacial_core.tooltip: The cold heart of a Hailstone Golem. It never melts.
item.stormreach.aurora_dust.tooltip: Shed by Aurora Moths at night. Makes Aurora Glass.
item.stormreach.bottled_stormfly.tooltip: A glass bottle used on a Stormfly. Put it in a jar for a lamp.

item.stormreach.stormchaser_trousers.too: Speed I in the rain. Full suit: immune to lightning.
item.stormreach.stormchaser_boots.toolti: Speed I in the rain. Full suit: immune to lightning.

jei.stormreach.power.turbine: Makes 2 SU a tick per level of wind, up to 30 in a gale. Needs open sky.
jei.stormreach.power.wheel: Makes 4 SU a tick for each side or the bottom with moving water against it, up to 16.
jei.stormreach.power.wheel_storm: Moving Stormwater doubles a Water Wheel's output, up to 32 SU a tick.
jei.stormreach.power.capacitor: Stores 100,000 SU. Lightning striking within 24 blocks fills half of it at once. Feeds machines on its network.
jei.stormreach.power.lamp: Uses 1 SU a tick. Light level 15 while powered.
jei.stormreach.power.plate: Uses 100 SU per shock: 4 damage to a hostile mob standing on it, up to twice a second.
jei.stormreach.power.pump: Uses 80 SU to lift 250 mB from the water source beneath it into a tank beside or above it.
jei.stormreach.power.sprinkler: Uses 80 SU and 50 mB from a tank it sits on or beside every 2 seconds to water a 9x9 area.
jei.stormreach.power.tesla: Draws 20 SU per point of charge from the network.
jei.stormreach.power.tesla_cell: A Storm Cell charges a Tesla Coil halfway. Lightning within 24 blocks does too.
jei.stormreach.water.rain: A Rain Barrel under open sky catches 25 mB of rain a second.
jei.stormreach.water.thunder: In a thunderstorm it catches 60 mB a second, as Stormwater.
jei.stormreach.water.drain: A Rain Barrel set on a Cistern drains into it, 250 mB a second.
jei.stormreach.water.pump: An Electric Pump lifts water from below. Ponds, rivers and the sea never run dry; a lone source does.
jei.stormreach.water.bucket: Use a bucket on a Rain Barrel or Cistern holding a bucket or more.
jei.stormreach.water.storm_bucket: A tank holding Stormwater fills buckets with Stormwater.
jei.stormreach.water.bottle: Use a glass bottle on a tank for a water bottle (250 mB).
jei.stormreach.water.pour: Pour water or Stormwater buckets into a tank.
jei.stormreach.water.sprinkler: Keeps farmland wet, gives crops and saplings an extra growth tick (two with Stormwater), and puts out fires.
jei.stormreach.water.wheel: Moving water against a Water Wheel makes power.
jei.stormreach.catch.stormfly: Use a glass bottle on a Stormfly. They swarm before and during storms.
jei.stormreach.catch.lightning: Hold an empty glass bottle within 8 blocks of a lightning strike.
jei.stormreach.catch.dust_devil: Use a glass bottle on a Dust Devil (deserts, badlands and savannas on clear days).
jei.stormreach.catch.collector: A Storm Collector under open sky charges in rain and storms. When full, take a Storm Cell with an empty hand.
jei.stormreach.catch.gale_sprite: Give a Gale Sprite Thistle Down and it gives you a Gale Essence.
jei.stormreach.catch.sparkskink: A storm-charged Sparkskink sheds a Charged Scale every few minutes.
jei.stormreach.catch.whale: A Cloud Whale leaves a lump of Cloud Ambergris every five to ten minutes.
jei.stormreach.catch.moth: Aurora Moths shed Aurora Dust at night.
jei.stormreach.catch.gull: Storm Gulls lay eggs every five to ten minutes.
jei.stormreach.catch.barrel_bottle: Any Rain Barrel or Cistern with water fills glass bottles.
Build a Storm Capacitor to store the storm's power

advancements.stormreach.cistern.descript: Build a Cistern to store captured rain

advancements.stormreach.sprinkler.descri: Build a Sprinkler to water your crops
enchantment.stormreach.capacity.desc: Backpacks only. Adds 9 slots per level.
enchantment.stormreach.magnetism.desc: Backpacks only. Pulls nearby dropped items into the pack.
enchantment.stormreach.organization.desc: Backpacks only. Sorts the pack every time you close it.
enchantment.stormreach.resilience.desc: Backpacks only. A dropped pack survives fire, lava, explosions and cactus, and floats back up out of the void.
enchantment.stormreach.soulbound.desc: Backpacks only. You keep the pack when you die.
enchantment.stormreach.conductive.desc: Every hit also shocks the target with lightning damage.
enchantment.stormreach.galeforce.desc: Boots. You move faster in the rain under open sky.
desc.stormreach.storm_shard: A splinter of solidified storm, dropped by Squalls. The base of Stormshard gear and most storm instruments.
desc.stormreach.storm_cell: A bottled charge of a whole thunderstorm. Wakes a Stormheart, and powers the better backpacks and radar.
desc.stormreach.tempest_core: The core of a spent storm, crackling and fire-proof. Repairs the Stormbreaker and builds the top-tier backpack.
desc.stormreach.gull_feather: A grey-white feather from a Storm Gull. Repairs Gale Wings.
desc.stormreach.salt: Coarse sea salt. Cures fish and keeps food on a long voyage.
desc.stormreach.fulgurite_shard: A shard of glass fused by a lightning strike in sand.
desc.stormreach.crab_claw: A Cliff Crab claw. Not much meat raw; cook it.
desc.stormreach.gull_egg: A speckled Storm Gull egg. Fry it for a decent breakfast.
desc.stormreach.charged_scale: A scale shed by a storm-charged Sparkskink. Still tingles.
desc.stormreach.cloud_ambergris: A waxy lump left behind by a Cloud Whale. A key ingredient of Skylight Lanterns.
desc.stormreach.glowgel: Luminous jelly from a Storm Jelly. Packs into Glowgel Blocks and lights Skylight Lanterns.
desc.stormreach.gale_essence: A wisp of living wind, given by a Gale Sprite in thanks for Thistle Down.
desc.stormreach.pearlescent_shell: A pearly shell left by a Tidewrack Hermit. Makes Nacre and the Tide Conch.
desc.stormreach.thunderbird_plume: A lightning-blue flight feather from a Thunderbird. The sail of a Stormkite.
desc.stormreach.thistle_down: Fluff shed by Thistlehops and Sparkfern. Three make a string; Gale Sprites love it.
desc.stormreach.glimmer_antler: A shed antler that glows faintly. The Doppler Radar needs one.
desc.stormreach.raw_voltite: Raw Voltite from deep in the Tempest Realm. Smelt it into an ingot.
desc.stormreach.voltite_ingot: A charged metal from the Tempest Realm. Voltite gear arcs to nearby enemies.
desc.stormreach.aurorite: A gem that holds the colours of the aurora. Makes the strongest realm gear.
desc.stormreach.stormhawk_feather: A feather from a Stormhawk, the realm's sky hunter.
desc.stormreach.ion_shard: A crystal of pure static from a Static Wisp. Crunch it to heal instantly.
desc.stormreach.serpent_scale: An iridescent scale from a Squall Serpent. Repairs the Gale Blade and builds Serpentscale Blocks.
desc.stormreach.squall_heart: The still eye of a Squall Serpent, still turning. The heart of a Gale Blade.
desc.stormreach.glacial_core: The never-melting heart of a Hailstone Golem. Makes Glacial Lamps.
desc.stormreach.aurora_dust: Shimmering dust shed by Aurora Moths at night. Colours glass with the aurora.
desc.stormreach.tempest_eye: An Eye torn from the Tempest Sovereign's crown. Sixteen of them open a Stormgate.
desc.stormreach.tempest_sigil: A summoning sigil. Offered at a Sovereign Altar, it calls the Tempest Sovereign down.
desc.stormreach.maelstrom_core: What was left of Cyrrus when the storm let go. Builds the Maelstrom Backpack.
desc.stormreach.hollow_remnant: A cold, humming relic left where the Stranger stood.
desc.stormreach.heart_of_the_labyrinth: A heart, still beating, from the deepest room of the Labyrinth.
desc.stormreach.cooked_crab_claw: A roasted Cliff Crab claw. Filling, and easy to find along the coast.
desc.stormreach.crab_cakes: Crab meat pressed into cakes and fried. One of the coast's best meals.
desc.stormreach.fried_gull_egg: A fried Storm Gull egg. Simple and filling.
desc.stormreach.stormberries: Tart, fizzy berries from the Stormberry Shrub. A quick bite with a burst of speed. Plant them to grow a shrub.
desc.stormreach.stormberry_pie: A thick pie of Stormberries. Filling, with a longer burst of speed.
desc.stormreach.stormberry_jam: Stormberries boiled down with sugar. A strong, long burst of speed.
desc.stormreach.stormberry_juice: Pressed Stormberries. Springy: it gives Jump Boost.
desc.stormreach.storm_chowder: A hearty coastal chowder. Very filling, and it toughens you up (Resistance).
desc.stormreach.sailors_stew: The coast's most filling meal, with a little Regeneration.
desc.stormreach.seaweed_salad: Kelp and sea greens. Lets you breathe underwater for a while.
desc.stormreach.salted_cod: Cod cured in sea salt. Very filling and keeps for ever.
desc.stormreach.thrift_tea: Tea brewed from Sea Thrift. Soothing: a little Regeneration, and you can always drink it.
desc.stormreach.stormfin: A raw Stormfin, caught in storm-churned water. Cook it.
desc.stormreach.cooked_stormfin: A grilled Stormfin. Filling, and it quickens your hands (Haste).
desc.stormreach.voltaic_eel: A raw Voltaic Eel, still faintly charged. Cook it first.
desc.stormreach.cooked_voltaic_eel: A grilled Voltaic Eel. Good, solid food.
desc.stormreach.tempest_tonic: A fizzing storm brew: Strength, Speed II and a Static Charge for a minute.
desc.stormreach.rock_candy: Salt-crystal candy. Always edible, with a sugar rush of Haste II.
desc.stormreach.stormfruit: A glowing fruit from the Elderstorm trees. Speed, and a crackle of Static Charge.
desc.stormreach.gilded_stormfruit: A Stormfruit dipped in gold: strong Regeneration and Absorption. Something old would like it.
desc.stormreach.stormfruit_preserve: Stormfruit preserved in a jar. A long burst of Speed II.
desc.stormreach.cloudberries: Light, airy berries from the Tempest Realm. Eat them to drift down slowly.
desc.stormreach.cloudberry_tart: A tart of Cloudberries. Springy: Jump Boost II for half a minute.
desc.stormreach.raw_skyray: Raw Skyray meat from the Tempest Realm. Cook it.
desc.stormreach.cooked_skyray: Roasted Skyray. One of the realm's best meals.
desc.stormreach.storm_nectar: Sweet nectar from the Tempest Realm's flowers, in a bottle.
desc.stormreach.gale_bread: Bread baked from realm grain. Plain and filling.
desc.stormreach.chasers_coffee: A strong thermos-brew for long chase days: Speed, Haste and Night Vision for two minutes.
desc.stormreach.snow_cone: Shaved ice and berry syrup. Cools you right down: Fire Resistance for 30 seconds.
desc.stormreach.bottled_rain: A storm, corked. Uncork it to start a Gale.
desc.stormreach.bottled_sunshine: A clear sky, corked. Uncork it to clear the weather.
desc.stormreach.bottled_thunder: A thunderclap, corked. Uncork it to start a short Thunderhead.
desc.stormreach.squall_in_a_bottle: A captured Squall. Throw it to burst into a gust; throw it at your feet to launch yourself.
desc.stormreach.bottled_gale: Gale Essence in a bottle. Drink it to jump high and fall slowly.
desc.stormreach.bottled_stormfly: A Stormfly caught in a bottle, glowing softly. Put it in a jar for a lamp.
desc.stormreach.bottled_lightning: A real lightning bolt in a bottle. Throw it to call the strike down where it lands.
desc.stormreach.cloud_seeder: A rocket that sows the clouds. Fire it outdoors to bring rain.
desc.stormreach.supercell_seeder: A heavy seeding rocket. Fire it outdoors to start a full thunderstorm.
desc.stormreach.weather_event_ball_light: Creative tool: release a swarm of ball lightning.
desc.stormreach.weather_event_dispel: Creative tool: clears every tornado and weather event in the world.
desc.stormreach.weather_event_downburst: Creative tool: drop a downburst, a blast of wind straight down that flattens everything.
desc.stormreach.weather_event_supercell: Creative tool: start a supercell thunderstorm that can drop tornadoes.
desc.stormreach.thunderhead_horn: A horn carved from a storm. Blow it to summon a Thunderhead over the world. Single use.

desc.stormreach.tornado_spawner_large_we: Creative tool: spawn a huge, violent wedge tornado.

desc.stormreach.tornado_spawner_rope: Creative tool: spawn a dying rope tornado.
desc.stormreach.tornado_spawner_satellit: Creative tool: spawn a tornado with a satellite twister.
desc.stormreach.tornado_spawner_companio: Creative tool: spawn a tornado with a companion funnel.
desc.stormreach.tornado_spawner_stovepip: Creative tool: spawn a stovepipe tornado.
desc.stormreach.tornado_spawner_waterspo: Creative tool: spawn a waterspout (over water).
desc.stormreach.tornado_spawner_wedge: Creative tool: spawn a wide wedge tornado.
desc.stormreach.tornado_director: Creative tool: steer the nearest tornado to where you point.
desc.stormreach.realm_pass: Creative tool: travel to the Tempest Realm and back.
desc.stormreach.stormshard_sword: A blade of storm shards. In a thunderstorm, hits may call lightning on the target.
desc.stormreach.stormshard_pickaxe: A tool of storm shards, a step past iron.

desc.stormreach.voltite_pickaxe: A tool of charged Voltite from the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.voltite_axe: A tool of charged Voltite from the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.voltite_shovel: A tool of charged Voltite from the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.voltite_hoe: A tool of charged Voltite from the Tempest Realm.

desc.stormreach.voltite_leggings: Voltite armour from the Tempest Realm. A full set has a set bonus.
desc.stormreach.voltite_boots: Voltite armour from the Tempest Realm. A full set has a set bonus.

desc.stormreach.cloudstep_boots: Boots stitched from cloud. No fall damage, and you can glide.
desc.stormreach.gale_wings: Wings of gull feathers and wind. Wear them to glide, like an elytra.
desc.stormreach.stormbreaker: A great hammer forged around a Tempest Core. Use it to unleash a thunderclap shockwave.
desc.stormreach.weatherbreaker: A storm-forged weapon. Hits hurl the target with wind, and one in four calls lightning.
desc.stormreach.tempest_staff: A staff that calls lightning where you aim. Free to use during a thunderstorm.
desc.stormreach.weathervane_scepter: A sceptre that commands the weather.
desc.stormreach.gale_blade: A sword forged around a Squall Heart. Every hit throws the target into the air.
desc.stormreach.stormcrown: The crown of the storm. Its wearer can't be hurt by lightning.
desc.stormreach.storm_chaser_cap: A well-worn chaser's cap with a radio in the brim. Warns you of tornadoes nearby.
desc.stormreach.chasers_badge: Proof you've stood in front of an EF5. Carried, it halves tornado damage and warns you of tornadoes.
desc.stormreach.lightning_charm: A charm of twisted fulgurite. In your offhand it grounds you against lightning and storm winds.
desc.stormreach.stormchaser_goggles: Chaser's goggles with a heads-up display of the nearest tornado.
desc.stormreach.stormchaser_jacket: A storm-orange chase jacket with reflective tape, braced against the wind.
desc.stormreach.stormchaser_trousers: Rain-proof chase trousers with knee pads.
desc.stormreach.stormchaser_boots: Rubber-soled chase boots for running through the rain.
desc.stormreach.stormkite: A kite of Thunderbird Plumes. Hold it while falling to glide.
desc.stormreach.tide_conch: A conch with a golden mouthpiece. Blow it for Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace for everyone nearby.
desc.stormreach.obsidian_backpack: A Obsidian-tier backpack: wear it or place it to carry far more. Upgrade it with the next Upgrade Kit.
desc.stormreach.obsidian_backpack_upgrad: Upgrades a backpack to the Obsidian tier in place, keeping everything inside.
desc.stormreach.diamond_backpack: A Diamond-tier backpack: wear it or place it to carry far more. Upgrade it with the next Upgrade Kit.
desc.stormreach.diamond_backpack_upgrade: Upgrades a backpack to the Diamond tier in place, keeping everything inside.
desc.stormreach.netherite_backpack: A Netherite-tier backpack: wear it or place it to carry far more. Upgrade it with the next Upgrade Kit.
desc.stormreach.netherite_backpack_upgra: Upgrades a backpack to the Netherite tier in place, keeping everything inside.
desc.stormreach.voltite_backpack: A Voltite-tier backpack: wear it or place it to carry far more. Upgrade it with the next Upgrade Kit.
desc.stormreach.voltite_backpack_upgrade: Upgrades a backpack to the Voltite tier in place, keeping everything inside.
desc.stormreach.aurorite_backpack: A Aurorite-tier backpack: wear it or place it to carry far more. Upgrade it with the next Upgrade Kit.
desc.stormreach.aurorite_backpack_upgrad: Upgrades a backpack to the Aurorite tier in place, keeping everything inside.
desc.stormreach.storm_crystal_backpack: A Storm Crystal-tier backpack: wear it or place it to carry far more. Upgrade it with the next Upgrade Kit.
desc.stormreach.storm_crystal_backpack_u: Upgrades a backpack to the Storm Crystal tier in place, keeping everything inside.
desc.stormreach.maelstrom_backpack: A Maelstrom-tier backpack: wear it or place it to carry far more. Upgrade it with the next Upgrade Kit.
desc.stormreach.maelstrom_backpack_upgra: Upgrades a backpack to the Maelstrom tier in place, keeping everything inside.
desc.stormreach.storm_chasers_pack: A chaser's 45-slot pack with built-in Magnetism. Earned, never crafted.
desc.stormreach.anemometer: Measures the wind: sustained speed, gusts and Beaufort force. Gives a redstone signal for the gusts.
desc.stormreach.thermometer: Reads the temperature, dew point and humidity.
desc.stormreach.wind_vane: Shows which way the wind is blowing.
desc.stormreach.storm_barometer: Reads air pressure, which drops sharply near a tornado. Gives redstone for the weather.
desc.stormreach.storm_detector: Senses rain, thunderstorms and tornadoes within 512 blocks and gives a redstone signal.
desc.stormreach.storm_collector: Soaks up a storm under open sky. When full, take a Storm Cell from it.
desc.stormreach.weather_station: All the instruments in one: wind, pressure, temperature and a forecast.
desc.stormreach.weather_monitor: A Weather Station readout plus the severe-weather outlook and full radar.
desc.stormreach.weather_radio: A portable weather radio: the forecast, plus alerts for tornadoes and storms while you carry it.
desc.stormreach.storm_radar: A short-range radar sweep in your hand, with tornado warnings while you carry it.
desc.stormreach.tornado_radar: A Doppler radar dish that finds rotation up to 1024 blocks away and reads out every tornado.
desc.stormreach.tornado_siren: A siren that wails while it has a redstone signal. Wire it to a radar or detector.
desc.stormreach.rain_gauge: A glass tube that fills with rain and slowly dries out. Comparators read how full it is.
desc.stormreach.tornado_probe: A weighted instrument barrel no tornado can move. Set it in a tornado's path to record the winds.
desc.stormreach.weather_balloon: A radiosonde balloon. Launch it to get a sounding of the upper air.
desc.stormreach.intercept_vehicle: An armoured chase truck with a tornado dashboard. Park it in the path and ride the tornado out.
desc.stormreach.chasers_logbook: A chaser's log. It records every tornado you witness: rating, distance, and your records.
desc.stormreach.wind_turbine: A small turbine that turns in the wind and gives redstone power for how hard it blows.
desc.stormreach.stormreach_field_guide: The complete guide to Stormreach: weather, tornadoes, the Labyrinth, the realm and drop rates.
desc.stormreach.storm_crafters_handbook: Every Stormreach recipe, with the real items.
desc.stormreach.journal_page_1: Page I of a stranger's journal, torn and weathered. Collect all five.
desc.stormreach.journal_page_2: Page II of a stranger's journal, torn and weathered. Collect all five.
desc.stormreach.journal_page_3: Page III of a stranger's journal, torn and weathered. Collect all five.
desc.stormreach.journal_page_4: Page IV of a stranger's journal, torn and weathered. Collect all five.
desc.stormreach.journal_page_5: Page V of a stranger's journal, torn and weathered. Collect all five.
desc.stormreach.weathered_journal: The stranger's five journal pages, bound together again.
desc.stormreach.labyrinth_key: An old key from before the Vault Door was rebuilt.
desc.stormreach.labyrinth_key_gale: One of the three keys to the Vault Door at the heart of the Labyrinth.
desc.stormreach.labyrinth_key_thunder: One of the three keys to the Vault Door at the heart of the Labyrinth.
desc.stormreach.labyrinth_key_hollow: One of the three keys to the Vault Door at the heart of the Labyrinth.
desc.stormreach.labyrinth_keyhole: Where the three Labyrinth Keys go, beside the sealed treasure chamber.
desc.stormreach.labyrinth_seal: Unbreakable stone that seals the Labyrinth's treasure chamber.
desc.stormreach.vault_door: The great door at the heart of the Labyrinth.
desc.stormreach.vault_wall: Heavy plating from the Labyrinth's vaults.
desc.stormreach.rusted_locker: An old steel locker. Step inside to hide from what hunts the Labyrinth.
desc.stormreach.hollow_lamp: A cold lamp from the Labyrinth's halls.
desc.stormreach.hollow_altar: An altar in the Hollow Shrine. Lay the Weathered Journal on it.
desc.stormreach.relic_pedestal: A shrine pedestal. Set the right relic on it and it glows.
desc.stormreach.storm_conduit: A shrine conduit. Strike it with lightning once every pedestal glows.
desc.stormreach.sovereign_altar: The altar atop a Tempest Spire, where the Tempest Sovereign is called down.
desc.stormreach.stormgate_frame: One of sixteen frames that ring a Stormgate, the way to the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.sovereign_trophy: A trophy of the Tempest Sovereign, for those who brought it down.
desc.stormreach.cyrrus_trophy: A trophy of Cyrrus, the storm that wore your face.
desc.stormreach.keeper_trophy: A trophy of the Hollow Keeper, for escaping the Labyrinth's hunter.
desc.stormreach.tornado_trophy: A trophy for witnessing a violent tornado, rated EF4 or stronger.
desc.stormreach.stormstone: Dark, rain-slick stone from the Stormreach Coast.
desc.stormreach.stormstone_bricks: Bricks of Stormstone, the coast's favourite building stone.
desc.stormreach.chiseled_stormstone: Stormstone carved with a lightning mark.
desc.stormreach.charged_stormstone: Stormstone that held on to a lightning strike. It glows.
desc.stormreach.skyshale: The pale stone the Tempest Realm's islands are made of.
desc.stormreach.chiseled_skyshale: Skyshale carved with a cloud motif.
desc.stormreach.tempest_bricks: Violet bricks from the Tempest Spires.
desc.stormreach.chiseled_tempest_bricks: Tempest Bricks carved with the Sovereign's crown.
desc.stormreach.voltite_ore: Ore threaded with charged Voltite, deep in the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.aurorite_ore: Ore glinting with Aurorite, in the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.ion_lamp: A lamp of static crystal that lights up the realm.
desc.stormreach.fulgurite: Glass fused by lightning in sand, in branching tubes.
desc.stormreach.storm_lantern: A lamp that holds a little storm.
desc.stormreach.stormglass: Glass made in a storm, tinted storm-blue.
desc.stormreach.salt_crystal: A cluster of salt crystals from the shore. Gives off a faint light.
desc.stormreach.glowgel_block: A block of glowing Glowgel. Bouncy, and it lights up the dark.
desc.stormreach.skylight_lantern: The brightest lantern there is, lit with Cloud Ambergris and Glowgel.
desc.stormreach.serpentscale_block: Squall Serpent scales, overlapped into a gleaming block.
desc.stormreach.glacial_lamp: A lamp of packed ice around a Glacial Core. Bright and cold.
desc.stormreach.aurora_glass: Glass coloured with Aurora Dust. The aurora drifts across it.
desc.stormreach.storm_shelter_hatch: A heavy steel hatch for a storm cellar. Blast-proof; open it by hand or with redstone.
desc.stormreach.stormfly_jar: A jar of glowing Stormflies. A soft lamp to stand on a shelf or hang from a chain.
desc.stormreach.stormheart: A seed of the Stormblight. Wake it and it turns the land and mobs around it into storm versions.
desc.stormreach.hail_layer: A layer of fallen hail. Melts in the sun.
desc.stormreach.puddle: A rain puddle. Collects on open ground in long rain and dries up after; creative only.
desc.stormreach.stormwater_bucket: A bucket of Stormwater, the charged water of the Stormreach coast.
desc.stormreach.stormlava_bucket: A bucket of Stormlava. Water hardens it into stone.

desc.stormreach.stormscar_turf: Scorched turf where lightning has struck again and again.
desc.stormreach.static_grass: Grass that crackles with static in the Static Fields.
desc.stormreach.skysoil: Light, airy soil from the Tempest Realm's islands.
desc.stormreach.nimbus_cloud: A soft cloud. You sink slowly through it and take no fall damage.
desc.stormreach.gale_cloud: A windy cloud that carries you along with the wind.
desc.stormreach.thundercloud: A charged cloud that flings you high into the air.
desc.stormreach.sea_thrift: A tough pink flower of the sea cliffs. Brews into Thrift Tea.
desc.stormreach.sea_rocket: A shore plant with pale flowers.
desc.stormreach.sparkfern: A fern that sparks in a storm. Shear it to keep it; it sometimes drops Thistle Down.
desc.stormreach.thunderbloom: A yellow storm flower. Makes a suspicious stew that gives Haste.
desc.stormreach.skybloom: A glowing sky-blue flower from the Tempest Realm. Makes a stew of Slow Falling.
desc.stormreach.stormcap: A glowing purple mushroom-flower from the realm. Makes a stew of Night Vision.
desc.stormreach.gale_grass: Tall, wind-combed grass from the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.cliff_crab_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cliff Crab, a scuttling crab of the sea cliffs.
desc.stormreach.storm_gull_spawn_egg: Spawns a Storm Gull, the coast's wheeling gull.
desc.stormreach.squall_spawn_egg: Spawns a Squall, a living gust that rams you.
desc.stormreach.thunder_crab_spawn_egg: Spawns a Thunder Crab, a crab that crackles with charge.
desc.stormreach.harbor_seal_spawn_egg: Spawns a Harbor Seal, a friendly seal of the shore.
desc.stormreach.brine_wraith_spawn_egg: Spawns a Brine Wraith, a drowned spirit of the storm surge.
desc.stormreach.ball_lightning_spawn_egg: Spawns a Ball Lightning orb, drifting and dangerous.
desc.stormreach.stormwarden_spawn_egg: Spawns a Stormwarden, a guardian of the storm.
desc.stormreach.skyray_spawn_egg: Spawns a Skyray, a gentle flying ray you can saddle and ride.
desc.stormreach.puffling_spawn_egg: Spawns a Puffling, a fluffy cloud-sheep of the realm.
desc.stormreach.static_wisp_spawn_egg: Spawns a Static Wisp, a crackling realm spirit.
desc.stormreach.cyclone_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cyclone, a whirling realm monster.
desc.stormreach.stormhawk_spawn_egg: Spawns a Stormhawk, the realm's sky hunter.
desc.stormreach.tempest_sovereign_spawn_: Spawns the Tempest Sovereign, ruler of the Tempest Realm.
desc.stormreach.stranger_spawn_egg: Spawns the Stranger, who follows you.
desc.stormreach.cyrrus_spawn_egg: Spawns Cyrrus, the storm that wears your face.
desc.stormreach.hollow_keeper_spawn_egg: Spawns the Hollow Keeper, hunter of the Labyrinth.
desc.stormreach.glimmerstag_spawn_egg: Spawns a Glimmerstag, a glowing stag of the Elderstorm forest.
desc.stormreach.thistlehop_spawn_egg: Spawns a Thistlehop, a hopping puffball.
desc.stormreach.cloud_whale_spawn_egg: Spawns a Cloud Whale, a gentle giant of the Cloudsea.
desc.stormreach.shock_eel_spawn_egg: Spawns a Shock Eel, an electric eel of the marsh.
desc.stormreach.sparkskink_spawn_egg: Spawns a Sparkskink, a lizard that charges up in storms.
desc.stormreach.storm_jelly_spawn_egg: Spawns a Storm Jelly, a glowing jellyfish that swims through the air.
desc.stormreach.gale_sprite_spawn_egg: Spawns a Gale Sprite, a tiny wind spirit.
desc.stormreach.tidewrack_hermit_spawn_e: Spawns a Tidewrack Hermit, a shy hermit crab.
desc.stormreach.thunderbird_spawn_egg: Spawns a Thunderbird, a lightning-calling raptor.
desc.stormreach.squall_serpent_spawn_egg: Spawns a Squall Serpent, a sky-dragon of the realm.
desc.stormreach.hailstone_golem_spawn_eg: Spawns a Hailstone Golem, a giant of packed hail.
desc.stormreach.aurora_moth_spawn_egg: Spawns an Aurora Moth, drawn to lantern light.
desc.stormreach.stormfly_spawn_egg: Spawns a Stormfly, a firefly that glows with stored lightning.
desc.stormreach.umbrella: A storm-blue umbrella. Keeps hail off you and lets you float down from a height.
desc.stormreach.omen_feather: A Storm Petrel feather that stirs before bad weather. Hold it up to read the sky.
desc.stormreach.bottled_dust_devil: A whirlwind in a bottle. Throw it to sweep up every dropped item nearby.
desc.stormreach.tesla_coil: A copper coil that stores lightning and zaps hostile mobs that come near.
desc.stormreach.wind_chimes: Copper chimes that ring in the wind: gently in a breeze, wildly in a gale.
desc.stormreach.rainfrog_spawn_egg: Spawns a Rainfrog, whose croaking chorus says rain is coming.
desc.stormreach.storm_petrel_spawn_egg: Spawns a Storm Petrel, a seabird that flies ahead of storms.
desc.stormreach.dust_devil_spawn_egg: Spawns a Dust Devil, a whirlwind of hot clear days.
desc.stormreach.copper_cable: Insulated copper wire. Joins generators, Storm Capacitors and machines into one power network.
desc.stormreach.storm_capacitor: A bank of glass jars that stores 100,000 SU of storm power. Lightning nearby charges it.
desc.stormreach.water_wheel: A paddle wheel that makes power from moving water.
desc.stormreach.arc_lamp: A caged electric lamp, as bright as light gets, while it has power.
desc.stormreach.shock_plate: A copper floor grid that shocks hostile mobs that step on it.
desc.stormreach.electric_pump: Lifts water from beneath it into a Rain Barrel or Cistern.
desc.stormreach.sprinkler: Waters the crops around it from a tank, so they grow faster.
desc.stormreach.rain_barrel: An open barrel that catches the rain. Thunderstorm rain comes out as Stormwater.
desc.stormreach.cistern: A stone tank that holds 32 buckets of water. Set Rain Barrels on top to fill it.
desc.stormreach.multimeter: Reads power and water: what a machine stores, makes or uses, and what is on its network.
item.stormreach.tempest_tonic.tooltip: Drink: Strength, Speed II and Static Charge (60 s).
item.stormreach.rock_candy.tooltip: Eat: Haste II (15 s). Always edible.
item.stormreach.stormfruit.tooltip: Eat: Speed (20 s) and Static Charge (10 s).
item.stormreach.chasers_coffee.tooltip: Drink: Speed, Haste and Night Vision (2 min).
item.stormreach.snow_cone.tooltip: Eat: Fire Resistance (30 s). Always edible.
item.stormreach.bottled_rain.tooltip: Use: start a Gale (rain and wind).
item.stormreach.squall_in_a_bottle.toolt: Throw: a gust that knocks things back.
Throw at your feet: launch yourself.
item.stormreach.bottled_gale.tooltip: Drink: Jump Boost III and Slow Falling (45 s).
item.stormreach.stormkite.tooltip: Hold while falling: glide the way you look.
item.stormreach.tide_conch.tooltip: Blow: Water Breathing (60 s) and Dolphin's Grace (30 s) for everyone within 8 blocks.
item.stormreach.gale_wings.tooltip: Wear in the chest slot and jump while falling to glide.
item.stormreach.thermometer.tooltip: Use: read temperature, dew point and humidity.
block.stormreach.storm_detector.tooltip: Redstone: 4 in rain, 15 in a thunderstorm or with a tornado nearby.
block.stormreach.storm_collector.tooltip: Charges slowly in rain and quickly in a thunderstorm.
Full: use with an empty hand to take a Storm Cell.
block.stormreach.rain_gauge.tooltip2: Use: read it. Sneak + use: empty it.
block.stormreach.tornado_probe.tooltip: Place it in a tornado's path; it records on its own.
block.stormreach.tornado_probe.tooltip2: Use it after the tornado passes for the reading.
block.stormreach.wind_turbine.tooltip2: Redstone: about 1 per 4 mph of wind (a gale gives 15).
block.stormreach.wind_turbine.tooltip3: Power: 2 SU a tick per level of wind (up to 30), sent along Copper Cable.
block.stormreach.storm_shelter_hatch.too: Blast resistance like obsidian. Opens by hand or redstone.
block.stormreach.stormfly_jar.tooltip: Light 12. Place it on the ground or under a block to hang it.
block.stormreach.aurora_glass.tooltip: Light 7. Needs Silk Touch to pick back up.
block.stormreach.stormheart.tooltip: Wake it with a Storm Cell, lightning or redstone.
block.stormreach.stormheart.tooltip2: The radius is set in the config.
item.stormreach.weather_balloon.tooltip: Use outdoors to launch it. The sounding comes back as it climbs.
item.stormreach.intercept_vehicle.toolti: Right-click to drive: W/S throttle, A/D steer, sneak to get out.
Press the anchor key (default Z) to drop the hydraulic spikes: no tornado can move it. Press again to raise them.
Sneak + right-click from outside to pack it up.
item.stormreach.umbrella.tooltip: Hold it: hailstones hit the umbrella, not you (each one wears it).
item.stormreach.umbrella.tooltip2: Hold it while falling: float down with no fall damage.
item.stormreach.umbrella.tooltip3: Careful in thunderstorms: it can draw lightning onto you.
item.stormreach.omen_feather.tooltip: Use: when rain comes or stops, and whether thunder is due.
item.stormreach.bottled_dust_devil.toolt: Throw: a dust devil stays where it lands for 10 s and pulls in dropped items within 8 blocks.
Catch one with a glass bottle in a desert, badlands or savanna on a clear day.
block.stormreach.tesla_coil.tooltip: Charges from lightning within 24 blocks, a Storm Cell, a power network, or slowly in a thunderstorm.
block.stormreach.tesla_coil.tooltip2: Zaps the nearest hostile mob in sight within 10 blocks (6 damage), once a second.
block.stormreach.tesla_coil.tooltip3: A redstone signal holds its fire. Comparators read the charge.
block.stormreach.wind_chimes.tooltip: Hang it under a block, fence, chain or leaves.
block.stormreach.wind_chimes.tooltip2: Rings more the harder the wind blows; barely at all indoors.
block.stormreach.copper_cable.tooltip: Connects to cable and power blocks on all six sides.
block.stormreach.copper_cable.tooltip2: Generators send power to machines first, then to capacitors.
block.stormreach.storm_capacitor.tooltip: Feeds machines on its network. Comparators read how full it is.
block.stormreach.water_wheel.tooltip: 4 SU a tick per side or bottom with moving water against it (up to 16).
block.stormreach.arc_lamp.tooltip: Uses 1 SU a tick. Light 15 while powered.
block.stormreach.shock_plate.tooltip: 100 SU per shock: 4 damage to a hostile mob, up to twice a second.
block.stormreach.shock_plate.tooltip2: Players, pets and passive mobs walk over it safely.
block.stormreach.electric_pump.tooltip: 80 SU per 250 mB, once a second, into a tank beside or above it.
block.stormreach.electric_pump.tooltip2: Ponds, rivers and the sea never run dry; a lone source block does.
block.stormreach.sprinkler.tooltip: Every 2 s: 80 SU and 50 mB from a tank it sits on or beside.
block.stormreach.sprinkler.tooltip2: Waters a 9x9 area: wet farmland, faster crops (more with Stormwater), no fires.
block.stormreach.rain_barrel.tooltip: Holds 4 buckets. Catches 25 mB/s of rain, 60 mB/s of Stormwater in a thunderstorm.
block.stormreach.rain_barrel.tooltip2: Drains into a tank below it. Bucket or bottle to take water out.
block.stormreach.cistern.tooltip: Holds 32 buckets. Bucket or bottle to take water out; pour buckets in.
block.stormreach.cistern.tooltip2: Comparators read how full it is.
item.stormreach.multimeter.tooltip: Use on a power block, tank or cable for a reading.
desc.stormreach.storm_block: A storm-touched %s, changed by the Stormblight. Builds just like the original.
desc.stormreach.storm_egg: Spawns a Storm %s: the Stormblight's version, with storm powers.
